stories.title: President, PM extend Diwali greetings to Hindu community, reaffirm commitment to minority rights
stories.brief: President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Sunday extended Diwali greetings to the Hindu community in Pakistan and around the world, reaffirming their commitment to protecting minority rights and promoting religious harmony.

stories.title: Husband held, investigation launched after anchorperson shot dead at Rawalpindi home
stories.brief: In a statement, City Police Officer (CPO) Hassan Mushtaq Sukhera said Ahsan’s husband was taken into custody and the suspected weapon was seized. The First Lady noted that the outcome of the investigation into Hina’s case was still awaited.

stories.title: Anchorperson shot dead at home in Rawalpindi, husband arrested
stories.brief: An anchorperson, Rabia Ahsan, was allegedly shot dead by her husband at their home in Rawalpindi, with police taking the suspect into custody and seizing the weapon used in the incident. Senior anchorperson Absa Komal said she was heartbroken over the death of Rabia, describing her as a respected anchor, dedicated journalist and mother.

stories.title: At least 34 dead as small boat sinks off Senegal
stories.brief: Senegalese Interior Ministry says one person rescued as search operation continues after migrant vessel capsized.

stories.title: Train collision in Egypt's Giza kills 4, injures 88: health ministry
stories.brief: Egypt’s railway authority said a train travelling from Giza to Fayoum crashed into the rear of another service heading south from Cairo to the city of Aswan. Authorities said they had launched an investigation into the cause of the crash, which occurred in Giza’s Al-Ayyat area, the site of Egypt’s worst-ever rail disaster.

stories.title: Train collision in Egypt kills at least 7, injures dozens, health ministry says
stories.brief: Two passenger trains collided some 76 km (47 ‌miles) south of Cairo on Sunday, killing at least seven people and injuring 112, Egypt’s health ministry said. Emergency crews were clearing the wreckage to restore ​services on the Cairo-Upper Egypt line, the railway authority said, without giving any indication of how long this would ​take.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz raises youth loan limit to Rs25m under business, agriculture schemes
stories.brief: The decision was taken at a meeting chaired by the prime minister to review the disbursement of loans to young people and the implementation of the two schemes.

stories.title: At least 21 dead after migrant boat sinks off Senegal coast, government says
stories.brief: At least 21 people have ​died after a boat carrying ‌migrants sank off the Senegalese coast, the interior ministry said on Sunday. Search and ​rescue operations were continuing as ​authorities looked for possible additional survivors The boat ‌was ⁠carrying people seeking to migrate irregularly, the statement said.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz briefs Nawaz Sharif on K-P security, economic challenges
stories.brief: According to the PMO, the meeting took place at Jati Umra, where Nawaz was briefed on the government’s ongoing reforms, particularly economic reforms, the challenges facing the country and measures being taken to address them.

stories.title: Lack of political ownership weakened counterterrorism efforts, says K-P governor
stories.brief: He said the government had directed officials to prepare a comprehensive plan to upgrade police stations, posts, lines and offices in the former tribal areas, including providing proper facilities and equipment. Kundi said the provincial government would also improve police welfare packages and the Security Challenge Allowance.

stories.title: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
stories.brief: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.

stories.title: Banana producers in Latin America want better pay to cope with effects of climate crisis
stories.brief: In the Dominican Republic, farmers are expected to face drought conditions, with forecasts of drier and warmer than usual conditions.

stories.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
stories.brief: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

stories.title: Standing in the way of slop bowls: the woman blocking food delivery robots
stories.brief: Tucked away in a dingy alley, opposite a garage called Patriot Parking, 78-year-old Carolyn Marvin is laying out some ground rules for a robot-disrupting expedition. Once a suitable target is identified, we will follow it to a busy sidewalk and Marvin will stand in front of the robot, blocking its way.

stories.title: PML-N retains both Gujranwala's NA-77 and Sahiwal's PP-203, unofficial results show
stories.brief: Notices were also issued to several PML-N lawmakers for alleged violations of the election code, mostly over visiting polling stations in the two constituencies. Earlier in the day, Chief Election Commissioner Sikander Sultan Raja visited the provincial election chief’s office, where he was briefed on the polling process in both constituencies, ECP said.

stories.title: 'Misplaced over-smartness': Maryam removes Jhelum DC over exam postponement for her visit
stories.brief: It is, therefore, requested that the examination be postponed and rescheduled for another suitable date to avoid any inconvenience to students and ensure the smooth conduct of both the examination and the VVIP visit”. Eventually, Maryam posted on X that the Jhelum DC was being removed from his post with “immediate effect”.

stories.title: Eisenkot says Israel in 'devastating diplomatic crisis' as he seeks to form govt
stories.brief: Israel’s former military chief Gadi Eisenkot started the tough task on Sunday of forming a government, reaching out to Benjamin Netanyahu’s allies as he warned the veteran prime minister had brought the country to a historic crisis.
